name: Butt Ends Meet
storyline: You take on odd jobs for the mysterious Mr. N, starting with a simple task: cleaning cigarette butts from the city's streets. As the jobs become larger and the city gets messier, you'll need to earn money, improve your tools and uncover just how strange your new employer really is.
summary: A low-poly first-person cleanup game where you work for the mysterious Mr. N, cleaning up the city one cigarette butt at a time. Collect litter, earn money and upgrade your tools as you take on increasingly messy jobs.
